item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 01/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be light and it will be very hot over southern China today and tomorrow. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. A broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Songda will move across the Yellow Sea towards the vicinity of the Korean Peninsula and dissipate gradually today and tomorrow. Tropical Cyclone Trases will move across the East China Sea towards the vicinity of the Korean Peninsula today.
